runtimeMapping.normal: Single Physical ground target; native Attack .4 seconds, Down uses Attack_Down; UP uses actual Back, other directions actual Front. Uncapped ASPD clock matches original maxAnimScale -1.
runtimeMapping.deckTalent: E2 Abyssal Hunter additive HP .20, potential5 .23; owner, bench and maxed support included before unit construction. Named build contribution survives form clearing; no module effects.
runtimeMapping.transitions: Source ghost2[switch2stand]/[switch2normal] sequences, transition immunities and double timed-buff clears represented by a bounded local two-clip scheduler. Die/Die_B then Start_B/Start_2 at fixed one-second Front identity. Full-HP write and SP reset precede outgoing clip; local mode entry is after outgoing clip, 20-second clock begins before born clip completes. Substitute fatal finishes its derived form buff and begins return; stale transition timers cannot affect later deployments.
runtimeMapping.substitute: No ordinary attacks or SP; zero block; x-4 range. Actual Idle_B. Per-recipient ground-only aura starts .8999999761581421 seconds after attachment then once per second; movement multiplier 1+selected move_speed. BUFF Arts damage, no SP, NONE application; target leaving and source detaching remove aura and reset its clock. Aura attaches after bounded local born phase.
runtimeMapping.s1: x-4 nonextendable selector, excludes owner and token professions, lowest-HP-percentage selectable other operator. Immediate ratio exchange at activation via waitForAttackEvent0, min1 direct HP writes with skipEvent. No heal/damage/SP callbacks. Skill_1 has fixed one-second cast phase; no fabricated Front OnAttack marker. ATK buffs apply for selected source duration even without a target.
runtimeMapping.s2: Selected ATK/ASPD, undeadable duration; skill finish forces substitute independent of HP. Withdrawal ends with death and cannot trigger form resurrection. Normal attacks retained.
runtimeMapping.s3: Additive ATK/HP and additive +1 base attack time; up to current blockCnt targets in ordinary range plus blocked priority. Native Skill_3_Begin .333 and chararts mix-mapped Skill_3_End .333; literal per-facing attacks .833 Front, .733 Down/Back. Every target evaluates HP percentages before primary damage: >= gets separate extra Physical NORMAL melee hit, else source loses3percentMAX HP with no modifiers, dodge, shield or SP. Fatal cost immediately enters substitute and cancels remaining ordinary release.
runtimeMapping.s3Ordering: The adapter applies native immediate active-buff action before the ordinary primary damage and processes recipients in local selector order. This is a scoped local dispatch interpretation, not recovered C# event parity.

verificationLimits: Only regular-stage 0-1 and this engine supported combat primitives are enabled; modules, native particle VFX/audio and additional stages/enemy skills are unsupported.

Native SequenceAbility/ComboAbility C# dispatch, exact double-clear timing, original counter phase and startup collision with external effects are not recovered. Local transitions use original one-second clips and preserve their forced Front identity; aura attaches after born and countdown starts after outgoing. No in-game frame parity claimed.

S1 immediate exchange follows serialized waitForAttackEvent0 plus authored gameplay note. Tied HP targets use stable local ally order; exact compiled selector tie-break and mode2/3 dispatch phase are unverified.

S3 active-buff-before-primary order and per-recipient local selector order are explicit adapter interpretations. External native buff ordering and simultaneous HP/form transitions have not been compared to the game.
Existing engine ordinary damage eligibility, dodge, rounding, hitbox/range boundaries and fixed step scheduling apply. Displayed art is original animation data, not the original Unity renderer.
